remaining_or_new_blockers: 当前 tracked runtime_receipt_manifest 仍是 review_round 0 的 2026-08-06 旧事务，缺少当前 nonce、冻结合同、精确 integration、implementation/verifier fingerprints 和当前关键 receipt hashes；CURRENT 中 tracked_runtime_receipt_manifest_is_stale=false 与真实文件矛盾。

当前 executable Verifier 与 frozen validation 仍明确失败：executable receipt 的 transaction 部分绑定较早 integration，报告 25 个事务/manifest/CI failures；frozen_verifier_validation_result 仍 passed=false。精确 hosted CI PASS 后没有完成同一 tuple 的 post-CI Verifier transaction PASS。

更深一层的实现 provenance 仍是旧 tuple：current_runtime_input_bundle.json 和 current_runtime_identity_receipt.json 都绑定上一轮 integration 965b0aad... 与 implementation fingerprint e7a6bfe0...，而当前 Planner tuple 是 ed2e3097... / d4b60e96...；checkpoint resume probe 也绑定 executor-local integration d400c003...。因此 formal runtime 的所谓 current identity 证据并不是当前被审阅实现的精确运行身份。

当前 implementation_fingerprint 又把 current_runtime_input_bundle/current_runtime_identity receipt 的 SHA 纳入 implementation fingerprint，而 bundle 自身嵌入 implementation_fingerprint_sha256。这形成机械自引用：若要求 bundle 内 fingerprint 与最终 fingerprint 完全相等，同时 fingerprint 又哈希 bundle，则无法通过普通一次性重建得到稳定精确绑定。必须把 immutable implementation fingerprint 与 post-integration runtime transaction binding 分层，而不是继续用上一代 fingerprint 填充 bundle。

当前 Verifier 的最终事务 required-artifact 集合未强制包含 current_runtime_input_bundle/current_runtime_identity receipt，也没有 oracle 检查这两个 artifact 的 integration/implementation tuple 是否就是 Planner 当前 tuple。因此即使 Controller 只重建 runtime_receipt_manifest，现有 Verifier 仍可能在 stale formal-runtime identity 未修时给出事务 PASS。

blocking_findings.contract_clause_or_field: sections 0, 13 and 16 current runtime/checkpoint provenance and exact Planner transaction binding
blocking_findings.observed_violation: Current runtime input bundle/identity receipt are tracked as implementation evidence but still bind integration 965b0aad... and implementation fingerprint e7a6bfe0..., not current ed2e3097... / d4b60e96.... The implementation fingerprint also hashes the bundle while the bundle embeds an implementation fingerprint, creating a circular binding design that is currently resolved only by embedding the previous fingerprint.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: A later formal run could pass its local current-runtime check while being proven against an older implementation tuple. Planner PASS requires the exact current implementation/runtime transaction to be replayable, not merely source-compatible with a prior tuple.
required_repair: Separate immutable implementation fingerprint inputs from post-integration runtime transaction artifacts so there is no self-hashing cycle.

Keep the formal runtime fail-closed validation before materialization/forward, but make the runtime binding artifact generated for and validated against the exact current reviewed integration, nonce, frozen contract, verifier fingerprint and immutable implementation identity.
Regenerate current runtime identity and checkpoint/resume provenance evidence on the new exact transaction without formal training, outer access, deployment or upload.

blocking_findings.contract_clause_or_field: sections 15-16 executable known-bad coverage and exact runtime receipt transaction
blocking_findings.observed_violation: Verifier now validates the runtime manifest itself strictly, but REQUIRED_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_ARTIFACTS omits current_runtime_input_bundle/current_runtime_identity_receipt and no blocking oracle compares their internal runtime tuple to the reviewed Planner tuple. Stale current runtime identity therefore remains outside the final transaction gate.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: This leaves a reproducibility/provenance bypass after the previous manifest-oracle repair: the wrapper manifest can be fresh while the formal-runtime identity artifact it is supposed to authorize is stale.
required_repair: Add a non-circular current-runtime-identity oracle and require the relevant bundle/identity receipts, or an equivalent Controller-owned post-integration binding receipt, in the final runtime transaction with exact content hashes.
Add actually executed known-bad cases for stale runtime bundle integration, stale implementation identity, stale verifier fingerprint and omitted runtime-identity artifact; all must fail closed.
Preserve the pre-Executor immutable verifier fingerprint design; dynamic runtime receipts must remain excluded from the frozen verifier digest.

blocking_findings.contract_clause_or_field: section 16 steps 5-8 exact runtime receipt manifest, CI and Planner handoff binding
blocking_findings.observed_violation: Tracked runtime_receipt_manifest remains round 0 and current executable/frozen Verifier transaction remains failed even though exact hosted CI on ed2e3097... passed. CURRENT incorrectly records the runtime manifest as non-stale.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: The exact Planner review tuple is not replayable end-to-end, so hosted CI cannot substitute for the missing runtime transaction closure.
required_repair: After Verifier/Executor repairs, regenerate a current round-1 runtime manifest containing exact nonce, contract, integration, implementation/verifier fingerprints and hashes of every required current receipt.
Run hosted CI on the new exact reviewed integration and record the actual checkout SHA/conclusion.
Then run the production Verifier post-CI transaction gate on that same tuple; only a zero-failure executable receipt and passed frozen validation may be republished to Planner.

decision_rationale: PLANNER_REVISE_BOTH is required because the remaining gap is not only Controller bookkeeping: Executor-owned current-runtime identity artifacts are stale and structurally circular, while Verifier currently does not gate those artifacts. Controller must also rebuild the final transaction after both role repairs. No scientific contract revision or user choice is required.
